title: Diasend integration
body: It is an interesting option because Diasend incorporates the ambulatory glucose profile (AGP) which is a globally recognized standard for visualizing continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) so that it is easy for patients and healthcare professionals to identify glucose patterns and trends. independent of HbA1c.

comments.body: XDrip+ also incorporates the AGP.  It's found in statistics, and you can get it for today, yesterday, 30, 60, and 90 days.

Great, it's true, although it could include more data and be more complete.
